visualizations.name: line

visualizations.supplies: A line per series.

visualizations.name: indexedLine

visualizations.name: emphasisLine

visualizations.supplies: One series in the accent, every other in the same grey. Set `emphasis` to a series name.

visualizations.name: smallMultiples

visualizations.name: stackedArea100
visualizations.description: Trend with volume. stack='stacked' for part-to-whole, 'percent' for share.
visualizations.supplies: Bands sum to 100%: composition over time, with the total removed.

visualizations.name: rankedBar
visualizations.description: Compare magnitude across categories. orientation='horizontal' for long names, baseline=0 to diverge.
visualizations.supplies: Horizontal bars, sorted largest first.

visualizations.name: divergingBar
visualizations.description: Compare magnitude across categories. orientation='horizontal' for long names, baseline=0 to diverge.
visualizations.supplies: Bars growing either side of zero, warm one way and cool the other.

visualizations.name: lollipop
visualizations.description: A ranked bar with the ink removed. Use when the bar length is not itself the point.
visualizations.supplies: A stem and a dot instead of a filled bar.

visualizations.name: heatmap
visualizations.description: A dense grid, colour = magnitude. The form for country x year at full resolution.
visualizations.supplies: A grid of cells, colour by magnitude.

visualizations.name: dumbbell
visualizations.description: Before and after per item. x must hold exactly two values.
visualizations.supplies: Two dots joined by a line, one row per item.

visualizations.name: slope
visualizations.description: Direction between two points, one line per item. x must hold exactly two values.
visualizations.supplies: Two columns joined by a line per item, labelled at both ends.

visualizations.name: bump
visualizations.description: How rank changes over time. Pair with transform='rank'.
visualizations.supplies: Rank over time, 1 at the top. Supplies transform: "rank".

visualizations.name: scatter
visualizations.description: Relationship between two measures. Add size for a bubble chart.
visualizations.supplies: One dot per item, two measures.

visualizations.name: bubble
visualizations.description: Relationship between two measures. Add size for a bubble chart.
visualizations.supplies: A scatter with `size` bound, so the dot area carries a third measure.

visualizations.name: connectedScatter
visualizations.description: Two measures against each other, joined in time order. Shows a trajectory.
visualizations.supplies: A scatter joined in time order.

visualizations.name: parallelCoordinates
visualizations.description: One line per item across many measures. For profiles, not for trends.
visualizations.supplies: One line per item across several independently scaled axes.

visualizations.name: choropleth
visualizations.description: Magnitude by country. Absence is hatched, never a pale fill.
visualizations.supplies: Countries filled by magnitude, absence hatched.

visualizations.name: bivariateChoropleth
visualizations.description: Two measures per country on one 3x3 grid. Answers 'high on one, low on the other'.
visualizations.supplies: Countries filled from a 3x3 grid of two measures.

visualizations.name: beeswarm
visualizations.description: Every item as a dot, grouped by category. Shows the spread an average hides.
visualizations.supplies: Every item a dot, nudged apart within its group.

visualizations.name: box
visualizations.description: Distribution per x-slice as quartiles. Use when the spread is the finding.
visualizations.supplies: Quartiles, median and extremes per slice.

visualizations.name: ridgeline
visualizations.description: Stacked density curves, one per x-slice. Shows a distribution shifting over time.
visualizations.supplies: Overlapping density curves, one per slice.

visualizations.name: statTile
visualizations.description: A headline number with its delta and a sparkline. Facet it for a KPI row.
visualizations.supplies: A headline number, its delta, and a sparkline.
